Research task. I need to know: on arXiv's listing page for High Energy Physics - Lattice (hep-lat) papers for January 2020 (URLs to try: https://arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2020-01 , https://arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2001 , and the export API http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:hep-lat&start=0&max_results=200 ), how many listed articles had a "ps" version available (i.e. entries whose format line showed [pdf, ps, other] with a ps link versus [pdf, other] without ps).

Try using webfetch, websearch, and bash (curl) tools. If a tool returns "permission required but no prompt available", note that and try the others. Report back: (a) which tools worked, (b) the total number of hep-lat articles listed for January 2020, (c) how many of those showed a ps version, and (d) any URLs/quotations you used. If nothing works, say so explicitly.

content:
**Result: nothing worked — I cannot answer the count question.** Report as requested:

**(a) Which tools worked**
- `webfetch` — **failed** on all three URLs (arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2020-01, arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2001, export.arxiv.org API). Every call returned: `permission required but no prompt available for webfetch`
- `bash` (curl) — **failed**. Every command, including a trivial `echo test`, returned: `permission required but no prompt available for bash`. This means bash is disabled by policy in this session (not a network/firewall issue — even local commands are refused, and no interactive approval prompt is available to grant permission).
- `websearch` — **failed**: `permission required but no prompt available for websearch`
- Filesystem tools (`glob`) do work, but a search for any locally cached `*hep-lat*` files found nothing.

**(b) Total hep-lat articles for January 2020** — Unknown. I could not retrieve the page, and I will not guess a number.

**(c) How many showed a ps version** — Unknown, same reason. (Methodologically, this data would come from the "arXiv:`...` [pdf, ps, other]" lines in the listing HTML or from the API's `<link title="ps" type="application/postscript">` entries — but neither source was reachable here.)

**(d) URLs/quotations used** — Only the three you supplied, all unfetched:
- `https://arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2020-01` → blocked
- `https://arxiv.org/list/hep-lat/2001` → blocked
- `http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query=cat:hep-lat&start=0&max_results=200` → blocked

To get an answer, you'd need to re-run this session with bash/webfetch permissions enabled (or an approval prompt available), or fetch the listing page yourself and share the HTML with me — I can then parse it and count `[pdf, ps, other]` vs `[pdf, other]` lines directly.
